note: Roads that close for the winter and are the only drive to a walk's start. openMonths are the months the road is open for most of the month, read from the road's operator or town on accessedAt; usually says, in the source's own terms, when it opens and shuts (part: early, mid or late). A walk listed under trails is out of season in the months its road is shut. Curated by hand; check each spring and autumn. Roads checked and left out, because they stay open in winter or the walk can be reached another way, are in checked.

tre-cime-toll-road.name: Tre Cime toll road (Misurina – Rifugio Auronzo)

checked.why: Shut in winter only between Afers and the pass; the road from St. Martin in Thurn stays open.
